mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as long as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 3.0% is associated with negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.4 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.4pp in 3 months is associated with positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over a 3-month period signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in 3 months
failure_condition: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in 3 months is associated with positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year), elevated consumer price inflation signals potential monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year is associated with positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1300 thousand units indicates weakening residential demand, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST below 1300.0 is associated with positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100 index) indicates a contraction in the real economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100.0 is associated with positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses short-term discount rates, leading to immediate positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as long as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 3.0% is associated with negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 1400 thousand units indicates strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1400.0 is associated with negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.
